thread:
anna: Starting rollout v3.0.0 during change window (eu-west). Routes: embeddings, text-gen. Step 1 -> 8% to new version.
deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started · job_id=rl-20260322-01 · step=1 · weights={v3.0.0:8,v2.14.1:92}
devin: Quick check — embeddings.p95 jumped from 180ms to 480ms at 09:12. Small 5xx bump to 0.4%. Link: https://console.redwood/slo/embeddings?range=10m
chris: Any infra alerts? NVMe IO steady, no OOMs. KV-cache miss increased.
ops-bot: [alert] SLO threshold exceeded for embeddings.p95 · duration=4m · recommend=hold_rollout_and_probe
anna: Hold further steps. Run 1% probe against v3.0.0 and gather traces.
deploy-bot: [automated] action=hold_rollout · job_id=rl-20260322-01 · note="held by anna: embeddings p95 spike"
deploy-bot: [automated] run_probe · route=embeddings · target_version=v3.0.0 · traffic=1% · duration=120s · probe_id=probe-6943210000
chris: Probe traces show slow attention kernel on long prompts. Trace: https://traces.redwood/probe-6943210000
devin: Given history, suggest partial rollback on embeddings to v2.14.1 while keeping text-gen ramp. I'll apply route weight change now.
anna: Please add audit comment when you run the weight API.
devin: Audit call: curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route-weight -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"embeddings","weights":{"v3.0.0":0,"v2.14.1":100}}'  # applied
deploy-bot: [automated] weights_updated · route=embeddings · from={v3.0.0:8} -> to={v2.14.1:100} · job_id=rl-20260322-01-weights
chris: SLOs recovering — p95 back to 170ms, 5xx 0.1%. Good to keep text-gen ramping.
anna: Update release notes: "v3.0.0 paused on embeddings due to p95 regression; partial rollback to v2.14.1 applied. Follow-up: ENG-5102 runtime perf triage."
ops-bot: [summary] partial_rollback_completed · affected_route=embeddings · followup_ticket=ENG-5102
